piece: Tue 17 Nov off day, auditrule (Home Depot rethink), cover
prompt: Photograph, 4:5 portrait. The hand-sewn felt robot from the reference photos, kept exactly as it is: cream felt with grey patches, a blank dark visor, the stuffing just visible at the unpicked seam down its front, three hanging threads in lilac, butter and coral. It stands tall and proud like a man posing for a portrait, chest puffed out, pressing a big round gold sticker that reads "I'M THE BEST" onto its own chest with one felt hand. On the desk beside it lies a sheet of identical gold "I'M THE BEST" stickers, a few already peeled off. Behind it the office is a disaster it has not noticed: a cracked monitor smoking, papers burning in a metal bin, sparks from a server rack, a toppled chair, a sprinkler spraying. Deadpan, comedic, cinematic. Deep ink-green shadows and warm light. The scene sits in the top half of the frame; the lower half falls away into quiet dark shadow with nothing in it. No other words, letters or logos anywhere.
